children: Tco Group Holdings, L.P., a 10% Owner, reported a sale of common stock on September 24, 2026. The securities were sold at $9.25 per share. The total sale amount was $92,500,000. Following the transaction, Tco Group Holdings, L.P. directly owned 102,576,555 shares of common stock. The filing notes the shares were sold in an underwritten public offering pursuant to the Issuer's Registration Statement on Form S-3 (File No. 333-297888). Voting and dispositive power over the reported shares held by Tco Group Holdings, L.P. is exercised by an LP Board comprised of Thomas Scully, Sean Traynor, Andrew Cavanna and Pavithra Mahesh, with the LP Board exercising authority by majority vote so long as one WCAS Designee and one Apax Designee comprise the majority.
